text:
Alex: Who's up for a 'console couch carnival' this Friday evening? I can host, got the projector and a big couch for 5-6 people. Thinking mashup of Switch, a PC LAN lobby, and some local party games. :popcorn:
Jen: I'm in if there's Smash or Mario Kart :controller:
Ben: I can bring a PS5 + a backlog of co-op indies. Also have spare controllers and a charging dock.
Maria: Would love to come. What time are you thinking? 7pm?
Alex: 7pm works. I'll open an official Steam lobby for the PC bit — lobby name: `couch-carnival-01`. Password `redwood` (will change at door).
David: Can we do any net stuff? I'll bring a switch dock + a small switch for handheld stuff. Also can bring a travel router if needed for port forwarding.
Alex: Nice. If we need port forward for the PC host it's `ssh -L 27015:localhost:27015 user@host` (super minimal instructions) but probably local LAN is fine.
Jen: I can bring controllers and a GameCube adapter for Smash. Also bought arena snacks earlier so I can add chips. :chipmunk: :thumbsup:
Ben: If anyone wants to bring a comfy floor cushion, yes please. My couch claim is weak.
Maria: My calendar is weird but Friday 7–11pm is cleared. Can we do a quick poll on games? Quick list: Smash, Mario Kart, TowerFall, Overcooked 2, Valheim (coop), Rocket League.
Alex: I'll drop a tiny poll in the thread in a minute.
lobby-bot: Poll created: "Which games for Friday?" Options: Smash, Mario Kart, Overcooked 2, TowerFall, Rocket League, Valheim. Vote with `+1` on your picks.
David: +1 Smash, +1 Rocket League
Jen: +1 Smash, +1 Mario Kart
Ben: +1 Overcooked 2 (for chaos), +1 Valheim (for chill later)
Maria: +1 Mario Kart, +1 Overcooked 2
Alex: Tally so far: Smash 2, Mario Kart 2, Overcooked 2 2, Rocket League 1, Valheim 1. Looks like Smash + Mario Kart + Overcooked will be the opener.
Jen: Also FYI I can bring HDMI switch so we can flip between consoles without unplugging everything. Multiconsole life saver.
David: If anyone has latency-sensitive PC stuff, bring wired mouse/keyboard. I'll bring an Ethernet switch for the LAN.
Ben: Cool. Who wants to be on snack duty? I can do drinks if someone covers chips/sweets.
Maria: I'll do sweets. Maybe small note: please label anything you want to take home. Last time we had a mystery controller. :laughing:
Alex: Perfect. Final call: Friday 7pm, address DM. Bring controllers and chargers. See you at couch carnival! :confetti_ball:
